correctness.rationale: With cumulative service m_i(t), conservation gives g_i(t)=g_i(0)+m_{i+1}(t)-m_i(t). Thus m_i(t+1)=min(m_i(t)+c,g_i(0)+m_{i+1}(t)). Induction gives lost service ct-m_i(t) as the maximum prefix deficit over lengths 0..t, and a full circuit has nonpositive deficit when H≥ck. Hence lost service ceases growing after time k−1, equivalent to every site being at or above capacity. Conversely a fixed point has all outgoing services equal; under H≥ck their common value is c. Attainment of τ=k−1 requires a strictly new deficit record at length k−1 at some i; subtracting all shorter prefixes gives exactly the strict backward partial-sum inequalities at the omitted site j. Two omitted sites cannot work since the strict inequalities for the complementary arcs would imply H<ck. In one event each backward word of length L=k−1 satisfying sum_{i≤s} a_i<cs leaves a uniquely determined inventory H−sum a_i≥c+1. In preorder with c initial root slots and c+1 slots added per internal vertex, immediately before the s-th internal vertex there are cs−sum_{i≤s}a_i slots; strict positivity is exactly what is needed, and the remaining slots become leaves. Lagrange inversion yields the stated Raney number; nonemptiness gives sharpness. The argument in fact also works for c=1, so c≥2 is a scope restriction, not necessary for the formula. Independent bounded replay: exhaust weak compositions of ck+j into k parts and simulate the displayed map until min(g_i)≥c, tabulating τ; all 24 cases c=2,3, k=2..5, j=0..2 agreed (e.g. k=5 counts 715 and 3060). The supplied verify.py in the frozen package is a separate, inspected but unexecuted replay. Finite agreement does not prove the general count.
